import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()

true_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "src/cli.py", "true"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert true_result.returncode == 0

false_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "src/cli.py", "false"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert false_result.returncode == 1

no_arg_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "src/cli.py"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert no_arg_result.returncode == 2

answer.summary: Added a dependency-free CLI entry point around the boolean parser with deterministic exit codes and a check beside the existing parser check.
